title: fix(cli)!: os validate refuses a field naming a sibling package's picklist without a declared dependency
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi97hkDTw4QcCCcbBHrZv1dPd)_

Fixes #31832

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Narrowing: yes. Measured: on base `cc16008a` the door accepts a field naming a sibling package's list with no declared dependency (the new refusal pin is RED there, see Verification); on head it refuses it as `picklist-reference-unknown`. The runtime already refuses the same reference since E6 (#31731): the boot warns and serves no options, the post-seal install judge refuses. Narrowing face: `os validate` / `os build` exit 1 for a `packages[]` artifact whose field `picklist` is held only by packages outside the declaring package's declared dependency closure (plus `sys`), when that package declares no dependency outside the artifact. First-party count: 0 (no `examples/**` app and no platform package declares a picklist; E6 measured the same).
Skills-docs: none. No published skill teaches a field naming another package's picklist; `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` mentions picklist only for `fieldPatches`.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`os validate` / `os build` 现在按运行时的规则解析字段的 `picklist`：先找声明该字段的包自己的列表，再找它声明的依赖闭包（加 `sys`）。同一发布包里兄弟包的列表，如果没有声明依赖，会被拒绝，提示句与运行时一字不差，并给出要加的那一行 `dependencies`。
- 为什么改：E6 之后，运行时对这种引用会告警、字段没有选项、安装被拒；可作者期的门仍然放行，作者直到安装才发现。现在 `os validate` 当场说清楚。
- 风险与回滚：收窄。多包制品里依赖兄弟包列表却没声明依赖的字段，从“校验通过”变成“校验失败”；运行时早已拒绝它，所以只是提前报错。第一方计数 0。回滚即 revert 本 PR，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`packages/cli/src/utils/picklist-references.ts` 的 `referenceResolver`（直接调用 `resolvePackageScopedHolders` + `packageResolutionClosure`，没有第二套闭包遍历）和 `refusedReferenceHint`；`picklist-references.boot-parity.test.ts` 末尾新 describe（门的句子等于启动告警的句子）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run src/utils/picklist-references.test.ts src/utils/picklist-references.boot-parity.test.ts`，预期 47 passed；其中 “a field naming a sibling package's list (ADR-0150 D3)” 一组在 main 上是红的。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（落地前席位做 CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER 合同审查并告知 epic 席位）。

## What changes

1. **The door resolves a reference with the runtime's rule, not a copy of it.** `judgePicklistReferences` builds the holders of each list from the bodies that declare it (`packageScopedHolderSource`), and asks `resolvePackageScopedHolders` (`@objectstack/core`) with the closure from `packageResolutionClosure` (`@objectstack/metadata-core`), over a registry view of the artifact (each body answers `getPackage` for its own id). Those are the calls the registry's `picklistReferenceVerdict` makes, so no second closure walk exists. Both packages were already direct dependencies of `@objectstack/cli`.
2. **A field's `picklist` resolves from the package that declares the field**: own list, then the unique holder in its declared dependency closure plus `sys`, else R's refusal. A refusal is `picklist-reference-unknown` with R's message verbatim (it names every candidate package and says to declare the dependency), and a hint carrying the exact entry, for example `'com.example.core': '^1.0.0'` added to the `dependencies` of the declaring package, plus the consequence (no options, values refused). No new rule id, error code or export.
3. **The outside-dependency arm is unchanged in kind.** When the declaring package also depends on a package the artifact does not carry, a closure refusal is reported as `picklist-reference-unverified` (info, never gating) with R's sentence, because that dependency could hold the list.
4. **A `picklistExtensions` entry's `extend` resolves with no caller** (epic-seat ruling X on the E6 card; the registry does the same), so an extension of a sibling's list still needs no dependency. Pinned as a CONTROL.
5. **A stack with no `packages[]` is unchanged**: it is one package, every list it declares is its own.
6. The module header's ADR-0130 paragraph is rewritten to the ruled rule, citing ADR-0150 D3 and ruling 6729820123, worded after child A's ADR-0130 note in PR #31841. The text-face heading over the reference refusals now names the closure case too.

## Tests

- `picklist-references.test.ts`, new describe "a field naming a sibling package's list (ADR-0150 D3)", 8 cases: refused with R's sentence (`packageScopedRefusalMessage`) and the dependency hint; two sibling holders both named; reported, not refused, when the declaring package has an outside dependency; CONTROL declared dependency; CONTROL transitive dependency; CONTROL own list; CONTROL `sys` list with no dependency; CONTROL sibling extension with no dependency.
- `picklist-references.boot-parity.test.ts`, new describe, 2 cases on a real kernel: the door's refusal message equals the boot's `findOutsideClosurePicklistReferences()` refusal for the same field; CONTROL with the dependency declared, the door accepts and the boot reports nothing.
- **Forced test changes:** `picklistRefusalHeading` CONTROL pin (heading text now names the closure case; renamed from "keep the heading they always had"); the boot-parity file's #29898 describe docblock (it described the sibling allowance under ADR-0130). No assertion of an existing case changed otherwise. The existing CONTROL in the first boot-parity describe (a body field naming a sibling's list with no dependency) still passes because it filters to `picklist-residual-unreferenced`; it is now also a stack this door refuses as `picklist-reference-unknown`, which it does not assert.

## Acceptance notes

- PR #31841 (child A, Tier H) adds a dated note to this file's module header saying the code still resolves against every body's picklists. This PR replaces that paragraph with the wired rule, so whichever lands second merges main and drops or keeps the note accordingly.
- `os explain picklist-reference-unverified` (`packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts`) still says the door resolves "against every picklist the stack declares". Outside this card's file surface; named in the report for the seat.

## Verification

Restored with `git checkout HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty, blob `582ba0e4` equals HEAD.

Head: Test Files 2 passed, Tests 47 passed.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: closure check put back to whole-stack resolution</summary>

`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `closureOf` with a closure holding every artifact package (anchor 1 to 0, marker 0 to 1, blob `582ba0e4` to `8d9cf978`). Result: 3 failed / 44 passed — the sibling refusal pin, the outside-dependency notice pin and the boot-parity sentence pin. The two-holder pin stayed green in the expected direction: with every package reachable it is refused as ambiguous instead, still naming both. Restored by the tool: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
</details>

All 63 ran on `8f820082`, every one exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 63 derived, 63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. (The first pass on `fcf3a4b9` had `check-adr-0087-registration` red: the narrowing changeset lacked its disposition marker; `8f820082` adds `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.)
